tools.title: Four Spiritual Laws
tools.description: Four truths about a personal relationship with God.

tools.title: Share Your Faith
tools.description: Practical tools for sharing discipleship naturally in everyday life.

tools.title: Romans Road
tools.description: A pathway through the book of Romans that explains sin, salvation, and how to receive eternal life.

tools.title: The Bridge to Life
tools.description: An explanation of how Jesus bridges the gap between humanity and God.

tools.title: The Abiding Life
tools.description: Practical steps for staying connected to Christ and growing in spiritual maturity.

tools.title: The Marks of a True Christian
tools.description: A lesson on the visible evidences of a genuine Christian life.

tools.title: The Privilege and Responsibility of Prayer
tools.description: A lesson on prayer as both a responsibility and a privilege of every believer.

tools.title: Reading the Bible
tools.description: A lesson on the importance of reading the Bible and how to do it effectively.

tools.title: Baptism
tools.description: A lesson on the importance, meaning, and practice of baptism as an act of obedience for every believer.

tools.title: Attending Worship Services
tools.description: A lesson on the importance of faithfully attending worship services as a mark of a true Christian.

tools.title: Giving to the Lord
tools.description: A lesson on giving as an expression of love, obedience, and trust in God.

tools.title: Separation from False Teaching and Practices
tools.description: A lesson on living separately from false teachings, sinful practices, and worldly influences.

tools.title: The Christian and the Church
tools.description: A lesson on the meaning of the church, the believer’s relationship to it, and its purpose in Christian life.

tools.title: Seeking the Will of God
tools.description: A lesson on how believers can know and follow the will of God.

tools.title: Offering Yourself to God
tools.description: A lesson on dedicating one’s whole life to God in full surrender and obedience.

tools.title: The Christian and Persecution
tools.description: A lesson on why believers face persecution and how to respond in a Christ-like way.

tools.title: Victory Over Temptation
tools.description: A lesson on understanding temptation and how believers can overcome it through Christ.

tools.title: Beginning of Your New Life
tools.description: An introductory lesson focused on building relationship, understanding the gospel, and starting basic Christian practices.

tools.title: The Beginning of Your New Relationship with God
tools.description: A lesson focused on assurance of salvation and helping the disciple grow in a personal relationship with God.

tools.title: The Beginning of Your Relationship with the Family of God
tools.description: A lesson focused on helping the disciple grow in connection, fellowship, and participation in the family of God.

tools.title: Strengthening Your Relationship with God (Listening to God)
tools.description: A lesson on how believers can listen to God through His Word and grow in sensitivity to His voice.

tools.title: Strengthening Your Relationship with God (Prayer)
tools.description: A lesson on how to pray, grow in communication with God, and understand how He answers prayer.

tools.title: Strongholds
tools.description: A lesson on understanding sin, overcoming strongholds, and experiencing freedom through God’s forgiveness and truth.
